verdict.rationale: pnpm supports lockfiles with frozen-lockfile CI enforcement, workspace catalogs for pinning exact versions across a monorepo, exact node.js version pinning via packageManager/devEngines and pnpm's own runtime manager, and strict node_modules isolation that prevents phantom dependencies from bypassing pins. Community evidence corroborates monorepo/version-pinning use in practice. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of exact-pin enforcement edge cases (e.g. overrides conflicts) and no direct third-party audit of frozen-lockfile behavior beyond docs.
